LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_SectionByMod: By the mod that adds them
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_ErrandsPassTraps: Vehicles you did not send pass over your traps
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_ErrandsPassTrapsDe: On by default: a vehicle of yours that is driving without your order never sets off a trap it rolls over. That covers trips to a dyno bay, gathering and delivery runs, a trailer being towed, a vehicle pushed by hand, and vehicles heading off with a caravan. A drive you order with a right-click is as before: a trap goes off under it only now and then, as under a colonist who knows it is there. Enemy vehicles still set your traps off as before. Off: every drive meets traps as before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_ParkedWarningDesc: How many days before a vehicle left parked in the wild is lost a letter warns you. At 0, no warning.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTrips: Vehicles are taken to a dyno bay for repair by themselves
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripsDesc: A land vehicle of yours with work that sends it (below) is driven to a working dyno bay by a colonist doing Drive work, repaired there, and driven home: to its depot bay, or a spot nearby. It never sets off while enemies threaten the map, and a vehicle in use is left alone. Each vehicle has its own switch on the Fleet board. Off: vehicles stay where they are until you move them, as before.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTrigger: What sends a vehicle to a dyno bay
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTriggerDesc: A vehicle goes only for work whose parts are in the colony, so a wreck nobody can repair never takes a place at the bay.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTriggerBayO: Only work that can be done nowhere else: a heavy overhaul, a tune or change of grade you asked for, a diagnosis you asked for. Fewest trips.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTriggerBrok: The above, and a destroyed part to replace (fitted at the bay it goes in in better condition) or a serious fault that needs a service. Routine servicing is still done where the vehicle stands.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTriggerAnyD: Everything: every due service, fitting and damaged part too. The tidiest colony and the most trips.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTowing: A vehicle that cannot drive is towed to the dyno bay
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripTowingDesc: A vehicle of yours fitted with the recovery winch fetches it: a colonist doing Drive work drives it over, someone who hauls couples the wreck, and it is towed into the bay's reach and let go. The tow vehicle then drives back to where it stood. It never takes a wreck heavier than the tow ratio allows; its brakes and clutch wear as on any tow. Off: a vehicle that cannot drive is pushed by hand if it is light enough, or stays where it is.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripPushing: Light vehicles that cannot drive are pushed to the dyno bay by hand
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_BayTripPushingDesc: With no recovery vehicle free, colonists who haul push the vehicle there, as many as its weight and the ground under it take: one or two for a car on firm ground, more on soft ground, and no more than six. A vehicle whose wheels will not turn, or a heavy one, cannot be pushed. Off: such a vehicle stays where it is.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_MessageLevelDesc: The messages in the corner that vehicles post by themselves: a fitting finished, a tank topped up, a part worn, a breakdown. Answers to your own orders always show whatever you choose here (a refusal saying why, a confirmation), and so do letters.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_MessageLevelTroubl: Breakdowns, fires, damage, losses and threats still show. Routine news does not: something finished, something neutral or good.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSettings_MessageLevelLetter: No vehicle message comes by itself, troubles included: only letters, and answers to your own orders. You may not hear of a breakdown until you look at the vehicle.
